summary: Join our Data Analytics for Environmental Sustainability Course. Equip yourself with skills to analyze data and drive sustainable practices for a greener future
lede: Environmental sustainability data analytics helps sustainability, compliance, and operations professionals turn environmental records into practical insights. The training covers building environmental data inventories, calculating emissions, modeling energy and water use, assessing supplier risks, and creating dashboards and disclosure workflows with Python and visualization tools.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals tasked with quantifying environmental impact and managing corporate sustainability disclosures.
modules: AI and Automation in Environmental Management
Science Based Targets and Decarbonization Roadmaps
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of environmental concepts and experience using Microsoft Excel for data analysis. Familiarity with corporate sustainability reporting is beneficial but not required. No prior programming knowledge is necessary, as technical tools will be introduced at a foundational level.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
